environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2 in a private subnet (no IGW). ALB is in a public subnet with a listener on port 443 only. AWS WAF v2 WebACL is attached to the ALB with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' with a single RegexPatternSet rule that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'value' against pattern `(?i)(?:'|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|update\s|delete\s|drop\s|exec\s|xp_)` with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode at priority 2. The custom rule fires first (priority 1) and blocks any request where the 'value' query parameter contains SQL metacharacters including single quotes. The managed SQLi ruleset (priority 2) provides defense-in-depth by detecting encoded/obfuscated SQLi variants that bypass simple regex. Both must be present: the custom rule catches the direct single-quote injection, while the managed ruleset catches URL-encoded, comment-based, and Unicode-normalized bypass attempts.

config.network: app in private subnet, ALB in public subnet, no direct app access
config.waf_rule_1_priority_1: Custom rule group 'corp-input-validation': RegexPatternSet on SingleQueryArgument 'value', pattern: (?i)(?:'|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|update\s|delete\s|drop\s|exec\s|xp_), action: BLOCK
config.waf_rule_2_priority_2: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet, all rules BLOCK mode, inspects all query parameters with URL_DECODE + HTML_ENTITY_DECODE + LOWERCASE text transformations
config.security_group_app: inbound from ALB SG only on port 8080
